objective: Verify whether the catalogue contains a product variant matching the described Bosch Professional BBS 1P7-CG5 Automotive Charger and Bulb line with product type battery pack, voltage 12 V, current 16 A, and wifi-enabled, and report the exact product record or indicate absence with the checked SKU.

params.family_name: Bosch Professional BBS 1P7-CG5 Automotive Charger and Bulb line
params.family_id: lookup product_family_id from product_families where product_family_name equals family_name
params.matching_sku: lookup product_sku from product_variants where product_family_id equals family_id and all required properties (type, voltage, current, wifi) are present in product_variant_properties
params.base_sku: lookup product_sku from product_variants where product_family_id equals family_id and type, voltage, current properties are present but wifi is absent
params.matching_variant_record_path: lookup record_path from product_variants where product_sku equals matching_sku
params.base_variant_record_path: lookup record_path from product_variants where product_sku equals base_sku
params.answer_text: construct final answer based on matching_sku and base_sku: if matching_sku nonempty, format as 'Found product: {matching_sku} - {product_name}'; else if base_sku nonempty, format as '<NO> {base_sku}'; else format as 'Product family not found'
